visual.general_description: Grayscale ultrasound image in a fan-shaped sector with a white arrow marking a region of the displayed cardiac structures.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale ultrasound sector on a black background, narrow at the top and widening toward the bottom, with a row of small white dots along each straight edge and a small partly cropped yellow glyph at the very top edge that cannot be read. Bright curved echogenic bands outline dark rounded cavities in the lower-left and lower-central parts of the image, and a bright band curves across the central lower area toward the right, ending in a slightly thickened, less bright linear structure. A solid white arrow in the lower-central part points up and to the right toward the end of that band. No printed labels, patient identifiers, measurement values, scale or color-flow overlay are readable.
